column1: # Shared product images (pinset p1). One line per pinned kernel x product
# profile, in pin order; TestSharedProductImagePinsMatchTestdata requires
# sharedProductImagePins to equal these lines exactly.
# Built by fullruntime.BuildSharedProductImage (cmd/productimages) from the
# objects build-product.sh rebuilds at the neutral paths /src/inspektor-gadget
# and /src/btf (stage 1: one CO-RE object per profile, shared_product_objects.tsv;
# qualified on both pins, shared_product_pins.tsv). The images are
# never pushed to a registry: node-agent rebuilds them from source into
# tracers.tar and must reproduce these digests. The manifest is the
# linux/amd64 manifest the agent pins; the index holds only that manifest.
# Stage 1: the image metadata has no per-kernel failure-frame target, so a
# profile's image (and its digests) is the same on both kernels.
# release
